_comment: House-wide equipment and business upgrades (room renovations live in rooms.json levels; bedrooms are built on lots). price: one-off cost. maintenance_per_day: ongoing equipment maintenance / subscription cost. requires: other upgrade ids that must be owned first. category: bonuses within one category stack with diminishing returns (stack_falloff^n for the n-th strongest). effects: room_attributes {attribute: add} applied to every filming room (or only 'rooms' types), capped at 1.0; content_income {content_id or '*': multiplier}; content_followers {content_id or '*': multiplier}; unlock_house_expansion: adds the top floor of the house (layout rooms marked requires_expansion), with extra rent (balance.json expenses).

upgrades.label: Ring light
upgrades.description: A cheap ring light that goes wherever she films. Flattering light for selfies, sets and streams.

upgrades.label: Phone upgrade
upgrades.description: A flagship phone with a great camera and stabilisation. Sharper posts and more shares.

upgrades.label: Wardrobe upgrade
upgrades.description: A rail of statement outfits, lingerie sets and props, so every set looks different.

upgrades.label: Softbox lighting kit
upgrades.description: Two softboxes and stands for proper studio-style lighting in any room.

upgrades.label: Editing suite subscription
upgrades.description: Pro editing software and a fast laptop. Every post and set looks more polished.

upgrades.label: Professional camera
upgrades.description: A mirrorless camera, lenses and a gimbal. Premium-looking sets and video.

upgrades.label: Streaming rig
upgrades.description: Capture card, mics, overlays and a second monitor. Livestreams look and sound professional.

upgrades.label: Set dressing & props
upgrades.description: Backdrops, furniture throws and themed props to change the look of any set.

upgrades.label: Bigger house (top floor)
upgrades.description: Add a whole new top floor with space for two more bedrooms. Rent goes up with the bigger place.
